entities.name: PC5 Relay RLC channel addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure for adding or modifying PC5 Relay RLC channels between L2 U2N Relay UE and L2 U2N Remote UE.

entities.name: sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModList-PC5
entities.description: Information element containing list of PC5 RLC channels to add or modify.

entities.name: sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5
entities.description: Information element identifying a specific PC5 RLC channel.

entities.name: sl-RLC-ConfigPC5
entities.description: Information element containing RLC configuration parameters for PC5 interface.

entities.name: sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5
entities.description: Information element containing MAC logical channel configuration for PC5 interface.

entities.name: Existing sidelink RLC bearer condition
entities.description: Condition checking if current configuration contains a sidelink RLC bearer with the received sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5.

entities.name: New PC5 Relay RLC channel condition
entities.description: Condition when a PC5 Relay RLC channel with the received sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 was not configured before.

entities.name: Reconfigure sidelink RLC entity
entities.description: Action to reconfigure the sidelink RLC entity or entities in accordance with received configuration.

entities.name: Reconfigure sidelink logical channel
entities.description: Action to reconfigure the sidelink logical channel in accordance with received MAC configuration.

entities.name: Establish sidelink RLC entity
entities.description: Action to establish a new sidelink RLC entity in accordance with received configuration.

entities.name: Configure sidelink MAC entity
entities.description: Action to configure the sidelink MAC entity with a logical channel in accordance with received configuration.

relations.description: The procedure processes the sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModList-PC5 IE.
The list IE contains individual sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 IEs.
The channel ID is used to check if an existing sidelink RLC bearer is configured.
If existing channel condition is true, reconfigure RLC entity action is performed.
If existing channel condition is true, reconfigure MAC logical channel action is performed.
The channel ID is used to check if this is a new PC5 Relay RLC channel.
If new channel condition is true, establish new RLC entity action is performed.
If new channel condition is true, configure MAC entity action is performed.
RLC reconfiguration uses the sl-RLC-ConfigPC5 IE.
MAC logical channel reconfiguration uses the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 IE.
RLC entity establishment uses the sl-RLC-ConfigPC5 IE.
MAC entity configuration uses the sl-MAC-LogicalChannelConfigPC5 IE.
